title: docs(runtime): drop an unobservable ordering clause from the released 6aa658a CHANGELOG entry
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DDwkEEJd65kqFZGFjQnzBQt)_

Refs #32995 (item 3 — items 1 and 2 land in #33274)

Area-lease pilot #33059 · area E2b · seat `domain:server#5` · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cz4f7zEQZ2C9GTG382

## What changes

One clause is removed from the released `@objectstack/runtime` 18.4.0 CHANGELOG entry for `6aa658a` (the bare action route serves the environment's own action declaration on an object no holder of the name binds):

> ~~An environment item with no object answers on `lead` too, and an item bound to `lead` comes before one with no object.~~
> An environment item with no object answers on `lead` too.

Docs-only. No code, no test, no changeset.

## Why

#32995 item 3 (epic red-line read 6842078446, text re-read 6842317355): the clause describes a case the registry cannot hold. It keeps one package-less item per action name, so the environment never has an item bound to `lead` and an object-less one at the same time, and the order between them cannot be observed. AGENTS.md (RELEASE-OWNED table, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md`) routes a factual error in a released entry to a dedicated docs-only PR that amends that entry, never an erratum in a later one. The clause appears nowhere else on `main` (`git grep "comes before one with no object"` → this entry only).

## Verification

- `git diff origin/main` — one line in `packages/runtime/CHANGELOG.md`, the clause only.
- No other file states the order.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
